upstream.description: Use your tokens to raise, evolve, and collect Pokémon! 🥚

classification.analysis: PokeTokenBar is a native Swift/SwiftUI macOS menu-bar app that gamifies AI coding token usage: it reads local usage logs from Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cursor, and several other CLIs, and turns tokens spent into a growing, hatching, evolving Pokémon companion with a Pokédex, shop, and rare-candy economy, on top of a genuine usage/cost/rate-limit tracker. All data is read locally from each tool's own log files with no external usage CLI required. It targets developers who use multiple AI coding CLIs and want a more engaging way to monitor token spend and rate limits than a plain dashboard.

use_cases.title: Track daily/weekly Claude Code or Codex token usage from the macOS menu bar
Gamify AI coding usage by hatching and evolving a Pokémon companion
Get burn-rate forecasts and alerts before hitting 5-hour/weekly rate limits
